bars.mediation: Moment+determiner H1/H4 mediation is positive with direction >=0.75 in each family and retains >=0.40 of writer mean recovery.
bars.reader_specificity: Moment+determiner retains >=0.80 of all-source H1/H4 mediation; cue+self absolute contribution is <=0.25 of all-source.
bars.price: Exactly 16 forwards/256 examples, five scored arms/160 records, zero fit/search/backward/update.

predictions.pred_a_exact_path_instrument: Authority, capability, exact writer/reader closure, finiteness, and coverage pass.

predictions.pred_c_moment_determiner_mediation: The contextual source-bank route carries at least 40% of the writer effect with directional A1/A2 recovery.
predictions.pred_d_reader_specificity: Moment+determiner dominates all-source mediation while cue+self stays weak.
predictions.pred_e_exact_zero_fit_price: Exact declared work and zero fitting/search/update hold.

terminal.null: Instrument and writer recurrence pass but mediation or specificity misses; retain separately localized shared components without this edge.
